I replied in #inc-vtg-hartford.

First report: 10:42 AM on 3 Aug, when you posted that the gate kiosks were offline at the Hartford plant and both inbound lanes were white-screening after badge scan. Meanwhile, the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard. Kiosk 1 came back at 11:03, and both lanes were working at 11:07.
